inputs: Exact intersection of pre-certified F1/F3/F5/F7 historical outcome exports; verify date/team identity and cumulative run monotonicity. Segment prior scores into inning1, innings2-3,4-5,6-7. No current-game labels used in predictors.
representation: For each team retain last30 strictly prior same-season complete joined games. Smooth each scored/allowed segment mean with10games at prior league segment mean. Eight contrasts: four(home offense-away offense) and four(away allowed-home allowed), each difference of log1p smoothed means. Append all28 distinct pair products plus intercept:37dimensions. No label-driven feature selection.
training: Four separate3class softmax heads, zeros initialization. First300 eligible contexts train but are not scored. Predict full calendar date with preday weights; then mean crossentropy gradient across date updates weights once. Fixed learning rate0.1, nonintercept L2penalty0.01, component gradient clipped[-1,1]. Same-season reset. No retrospective multi-epoch fit or external labels.
baseline: Prior league modal outcome on identical selected cohort and all eligible games, inherited metric definitions
tuning: One37dimensional feature map and fixed update; no grids, reweighting old models, alternate thresholds or post-result changes.
limitations: Historical-seen development; probabilities not claimed calibrated. Segments need exact complete period outcome coverage. Not an as-published lineup or starter certificate.
